Layer notes and methods
Core layers
  • Typology B: final spatial class for Scenario B.
  • NAI: local walkability, walking access to nearby everyday amenities.
  • MAI_B: metropolitan opportunity access after VinBus.
  • RAC_B: how well walk+transit competes with motorcycle access.
  • Delta_SMCI: how much VinBus changes SMCI.
  • SMCI_B: final capability index after VinBus.
Zero NAI caution
NAI = 0 means no mapped walkable POIs within the walking threshold. It does not prove there are no real-world amenities. In this pilot, zero-NAI built cells are analytically important because they also force SMCI_B to 0.

Diagnostic only
LISA uses Queen contiguity, 9,999 permutations, and FDR correction. It identifies spatial association, not a boundary effect or causal mechanism.

Crossing lines are modeled Network A/D topology, not confirmed public gates. Median near-boundary detour is nanx for walking and nanx for motorcycle.
